subject: the public root
ruling: The public root stays a deduplicated current-state set with sticky card membership. It is not an append-only log, and the public copy must stop implying that it is. The append-only property belongs to the signed card index and the corrections ledger, which are separate corpora; the root is the snapshot those corpora are summarised into.

implementation.gap: never in the code; it was in how the structure was described

evidence.claim: the builder says so in its own words
evidence.detail: the root builder states that the root is a coverage SNAPSHOT, not an append-only log; the leaf-union builder assembles it with RFC 6962 domain separation over the leaves it selects — a Merkle tree over the current membership set, not a chain of history

evidence.claim: the root's own history loses members
evidence.detail: across the 69-entry root history card_count moves in both directions: -2, -1, -3, -4, -6
evidence.implication: an append-only structure cannot lose members; a set can

evidence.claim: master and live disagreed on membership at equal size
evidence.detail: the repository root and the live root carried the same count but 67 different leaves
evidence.implication: a recomputed membership set, not an appended history: if it were append-only, the live root would be a superset of the repository root, not a different set of the same size

evidence.claim: sticky cards are the mechanism that stops measurement loss
evidence.detail: the builder's retention logic keeps a card's membership sticky so that a measurement already published is not silently dropped when the current set is recomputed
evidence.implication: coverage without false accumulation — the correct trade for a snapshot

evidence.claim: the append-only surfaces exist, and they are elsewhere
evidence.detail: the corrections ledger carries 58 withdrawn and 1,682 superseded entries, both confirmed against live sources
evidence.implication: the root summarises; the ledger remembers

counts_at_ruling.note: the two corpora have no id in common; neither is a subset of the other by construction, and neither may be presented as the other

counts_after.note: the Bitcoin-confirmed candidate merged into master at 09:52:51Z, so the root moved from 324 to 326 catalogued leaves after this ruling was made. The ruling is about the SHAPE of the structure and is unchanged by the count.

obliges: the public copy stops implying append-only: where the root is described as an append-only ledger or an ever-growing log, that wording is wrong and must be corrected
the two corpora stay named separately
the card index's count and the root's count are not a defect to be reconciled by fiat — two different corpora with two different membership rules
does_not: convert the root into an append-only log
change any count, merkle root, signature or leaf
confer any status on any subject

open_gap.against: the live register claims 92.86% coverage with due_unrun_next_read 26
open_gap.note: a published claim about a page that is not served — a separate open defect, unaffected by this ruling, and it stays on the docket

not_a_certification: This ruling describes the shape of a published structure. It decides nothing about whether any measured claim is true, and it grants no status to any subject.
